Reg Hopkins was a double winner in the youths' events, taking the pentathlon and the high-jump, while in this section, we also won the long-jump, through Stephen Crosbie, the shot-putt, through Dave Raffell, and the 800m., through fast-improving Dave Harvey.
Steve Crosbie was another to improve his best ever in this event. Mick Marshall's 200 metre runs have improved no end in the last few weeks and he won his heat in grand style.

The Crosbie brothers Stephen and Peter are having a good season helped no doubt by the coaching of Frank Simmons. In the Emanuel School sports Peter won the Discus and the Javelin, the latter with 47.50m, a new school record.

A double win from Steve White and Steve Crosbie in the long jump, a personal best vault from Reg Hopkins and very good shot putting from John Martin set an impressive standard that if maintained throughout the year should stand us in good stead.

Highlights included 22.9 for Charlie Gillett and 23.1 for Jim Evans over 200m, 49.8/400 Steve White, sub-50 from Steve and Charlie in the 4x400, 14:35.0/5000 from John Stow, 13.21/TJ from Steve Crosbie, 3.35/PV from Reg Hopkins ................................

It was good to see Steve Crosbie back to form in the triple jump. John Stow gave us our fastest league 5,000m of the year but still had to give way to SLH's redoubtable pair Roberts and Gevers whilst his partner Simon Lloyd had to vault the railings and run in flats to avoid missing the start.
In the long jump Steve Crosbie was close to his best in beating Reg Hopkins who took the high jump as only competitor, nevertheless with a good leap.

Only three athletes contested the jumps but there were no easy victories. The Triple saw Steve Crosbie scrape home by a centimetre from Arnold Bentt but Reg. Hopkins had the advantage in the High and Long Jumps.

Congratulations to Stephen Crosbie who has now become a qualified Assistant Club Coach in Long and Triple Jump. Stephen is regularly at Battersea Park on a Sunday morning and will be pleased to guide those who require assistance with their jumping.
